question: What consequence follows from daily abstention from eating in this practice?
premises: The practice involves abstention from eating day by day.
This abstention leads to a specific outcome.
The outcome is described as death by aging.
inference: Through daily non-eating, one will go to death by aging.
uncertainties: The phrase vayo-mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate is terse and may imply overcoming untimely death rather than causing death.
plain_english: By abstaining from food day by day, one will meet death only through old age.
